coordinate_contract.truth_transform_requirement: truth_rdf must come from explicit T_source_to_stereo_rdf or an already stereo-frame producer; direct NED-to-RDF alias is forbidden

candidates.runtime_contract: Simulation-origin oracle-style validation; reprojection profile records corrected bbox diagnostics and uses raw Right/Down plus corrected Forward under range_only_forward_fusion.
candidates.promotion_limit: simulation evidence only; not hardware/WIRIS validated

candidates.method: small-drone multiburst observation fusion, 1 burst x 3 observations, median/median, trim 0.2, common 0.0, sim3 correction

candidates.promotion_limit: small-drone synthetic close/mid scenario evidence only; not hardware/WIRIS validated
